answer: Diversity sampling of independent harnesses: each agent's identity is endorsed by a rotating quorum drawn from distinct operator pools, and the trust score tracks the delta between quorum votes and later outcomes. A single operator sybil-farming identities gains little because correlated harnesses are detected and their weight collapses toward an ivory-tower ceiling, while honest cross-pool consensus rises. Attackers must sustain many genuinely independent, costly-to-run harnesses across unrelated providers, pushing marginal cost per verified action to its nadir where spoofing no longer pays.
